verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a GitHub/GitLab connection only for deployments: it links a revision to a diff of what changed since the last deploy. Separately, issues can be exported to GitHub or GitLab issue trackers. Nothing documents suspect commits on an issue, code-owner assignment, or jumping from a stack frame to the source line on the default branch, so these are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform connects to my repos so an issue shows suspect commits and code owners, and I can jump from a stack frame to the exact line on my default branch
